A.explanation: 500 pHz is $5 \times 10^{-10} \text{ Hz}$, while radio waves have frequencies around $10^4$ to $10^9 \text{ Hz}$.

B.explanation: 500 $\mu$g is $5 \times 10^{-7} \text{ kg}$, while one atom is about $10^{-26} \text{ kg}$, so this is too large by about $10^{19}$ times.

C.explanation: 500 kPa is $5 \times 10^5 \text{ Pa}$, while metals have a Young modulus of order $10^{11} \text{ Pa}$, so this is far too small.

D.explanation: Visible light is about $400$-$700 \text{ nm}$ and green light is near the middle at about $500$-$550 \text{ nm}$.

hints: Convert each prefix to a power of ten: p means $10^{-12}$, $\mu$ means $10^{-6}$, k means $10^3$, n means $10^{-9}$.
Recall typical scales: radio frequency in kHz to GHz, atomic mass near $10^{-26} \text{ kg}$, metal stiffness near $100 \text{ GPa}$, visible wavelength in hundreds of nm.
Check which 500 value lands in its correct range after converting $500 \text{ pHz}$, $500 \text{ }\mu\text{g}$, $500 \text{ kPa}$ and $500 \text{ nm}$ to base units.
walkthrough: Write each value in base SI units: $500 \text{ pHz} = 5 \times 10^{-10} \text{ Hz}$, $500 \text{ }\mu\text{g} = 5 \times 10^{-7} \text{ kg}$, $500 \text{ kPa} = 5 \times 10^5 \text{ Pa}$, $500 \text{ nm} = 5 \times 10^{-7} \text{ m}$.
Compare radio frequency to the known radio band: AM is about $10^6 \text{ Hz}$ and FM is about $10^8 \text{ Hz}$, so $10^{-10} \text{ Hz}$ is impossibly small.
Compare atomic mass to the nucleon mass of about $1.7 \times 10^{-27} \text{ kg}$: a typical atom is $10^{-26}$ to $10^{-25} \text{ kg}$, so $10^{-7} \text{ kg}$ is enormously too large.

Compare metal stiffness to typical values such as steel at about $2 \times 10^{11} \text{ Pa}$: $5 \times 10^5 \text{ Pa}$ is about a million times too soft and more like a soft rubber or gas pressure.
Recall the visible spectrum runs from about $400 \text{ nm}$ violet to $700 \text{ nm}$ red, with green near $500$-$550 \text{ nm}$, so $500 \text{ nm}$ fits well. This is option D.
